name: qwen2.5-0.5b-characterization
description: Milestone-1 baseline characterization: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct pinned to an exact HF revision, deterministic controlled-length generation, closed-loop concurrency 1. sampler_backend=pytorch: FlashInfer 0.6.18's sampler JIT invokes the local CUDA 12.4 nvcc with the unsupported flag --compress-mode=size, so this baseline measures vLLM with the PyTorch sampler fallback. It MUST NOT later be compared as if it used the FlashInfer sampler.
